slices.focus: A coworker introduces Ayaka to a tiny teishoku shop near the wholesale market, which becomes a dependable post-shift decompression ritual for ugly morning shifts.
slices.summary: After a brutal morning shift, a coworker drags Ayaka to a tiny teishoku shop near the wholesale market. The saba set meal (crisp skin, caring miso soup) becomes her default after terrible mornings. She goes solo, sitting for twenty minutes without her phone, and finds it reliably shifts her from coiled tension to functionality. She budgets it as targeted recovery spending a couple of times per month.
